The compactor blade inside the body of the truck went to the auto return position, crushing the employee's head and killing him.

At 7:09 a.m. on August 27, 2015, Employee #1 was picking up debris along the curbside of a street while wearing a reflective vest, steel toed shoes, and gloves. A female driver, driving east on the street, struck a parked vehicle that then struck Employee #1, pinning him between two vehicles. The employee sustained crushing injuries to his chest and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by iron gate
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Forward Van Lines Inc. Fort Lauderdale, FL. At 7:00 a.m. on August 25, 2015, Employee #1 was lifting a cast iron gate, trying to place it back in the track. As he attempted to place one end in the track, the opposite end of the gate tilted forward and fell on the employee. Theweight of the gate crushed Employee #1, killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Holb-Sierra Corp. Stuart, FL. At 12:00 a.m. on August 13, 2015, an employee was installing low voltage wires above a drop celling for a security camera system using "A" frame type ladder. The ladder was on a concrete floor which was covered by thin indoor carpeting. The employee fell approximately 13 feet from the ladder. The employee received head trauma and was died.

events.title: Employee killed in a fall from ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Total Scapes Inc. Tampa, FL. At 10:15 a.m. on August 11, 2015, an employee was climbing up a metal ladder while holding a small chainsaw with his right hand. The employee proceeded to cut a tree branch but felt backwards to the ground. The employee hit his head upon impact with the ground and lost conscious. He was killed.

events.title: Employee passes out, falls and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Lutz, FL. At 12:00 p.m. on August 4, 2015, an employee was cutting bread to make croutons for salads. The employee felt dizzy, fainted and fell, hitting his head against the floor. The employee sustained a skull fracture and was killed. killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when run over by hay blower
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Agricultural Land Services, Inc. Boynton Beach, FL. At 1:00 p.m. on July 27, 2015, Employee #1 was applying straw to a dike. At the completion of the work, the crew drove back to the parking area. Employee #1 wasriding on the hay blower frame. He fell off of the back, onto the road and was run over by the rear tire. He was killed, sustaining multiple crush injuries to his upper and lower chest and abdomen.

events.title: Worker is Pinned by Maintenance Cart and Dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hampton Golf, Inc. Fort Myers, FL. At 6:30 p.m. on July 19, 2015, a worker was charging the battery of a power driven air compressor through the use of a Toro Workman maintenance cart (model number: 3200). As the worker stood between the compressor and the maintenance cart, he revved the engine of the cart in an attempt to speed up the rate at which the compressor was being charged. While straddling the cart with its engine revving, the cart lurched forward and pinned the worker between a work table lift and the cart. The worker…

events.title: Employee Collapses While Emptying A Garbage Dumpster
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ted Carter Enterprises, Inc. Key Largo, FL. At 10:30 a.m. on June 17, 2015, an employee had just emptied an 8 cubic yard dumpster into a garbage truck. The employee collapsed onto the ground next to the dumpster for no apparent reason. The employee ended up dying and no other information was provided pertaining to the employee's death.

events.title: Employee makes contact with an exposed wire and is electrocu…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Reyes Air Conditioning & Parts, Inc. Miami, FL. At approximately 3:00 p.m. on June 17, 2015, Employee #1 was installing an air conditioning unit and came in contact with a live exposed wire. Employee #1 waselectrocuted.

events.title: Employee falls from roof and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Joseph Block Air Conditioning Inc. Miami Beach, FL. At approximately 3:24 p.m. on June 16, 2015, Employee #1 was repairing an air conditioning unit on a roof. He was walking and appeared to step into the open side of the roof. He was not wearing any fall protection and fell 23.17 feet. Employee #1 was hospitalized and died later.

events.title: Employee is killed when mower rolls into lake
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Austin Outdoor, Llc. Vero Beach, FL. At 4:00 p.m. on June 6, 2015, an employee was mowing grass with a zero turn lawnmower on an incline. The mower slid down the incline into the lake entrapping the operator. The employee was killed by drowning.

events.title: Employee falls off horse and drowns in a cattle pond
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: C & M Rucks Dairy. Okeechobee, FL. At 3:10 pm on June 5, 2015, an employee was riding a horse herding cattle from apond. The employee fell from the horse into the pond and drowned.

events.title: Employee Suffers A Heart Attack During A Break
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Willingham Construction, Inc. Niceville, FL. At 3:00 p.m. on May 18, 2015, an employee was using a shovel to toss dirt into abucket truck. The employee took a break and used a water hose from the side of a residential home. The employee collapsed from a heart attack.

events.title: Employee is struck by lightning on roof and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: D. Peck Roofing, Inc. Bonita Springs, FL. At 3:21 p.m. on May 13, 2015, an employee was walking across a roof when lightning struck a direct hit. The employee suffered fatal burns to head and was electrocuted.

events.title: An employee is killed when rolled over and crushed by a back…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: 3Rd Generation Plumbing, Inc. Marathon, FL. At 11:00 a.m. on May 12, 2015, an employee stopped a back hoe on an incline. He then went underneath the vehicle to perform maintenance, but did not chock the wheels. The back hoe rolled forward and crushed the employee's head and chest. chest.

events.title: Employee dies from heart attack on a hot day
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jnakhladesign, Llc. Tampa, FL. At 4:30 p.m. on May 11, 2015, an employee collapse as he placing debris into a dumpster during a hot day. The employee was found to have died from a heart attack.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted while trimming tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: E & J Kingdom Tree Service Llc. Miami, FL. At 12:00 p.m. on April 28, 2015, an employee was trimming branches on a tree while standing on a metal ladder. The employee was killed due to electrical discharge from a 7.62 KV power line.

events.title: Employees is Killed and Another Injured When Compressed Gas…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Magnegas Corporation. Tarpon Springs, FL. At approximately 1:56 p.m. on April 16, 2015, Employee #1 and Employee #2 were draining liquids from compressed gas DOT cylinders containing unspecified compressed gas called Magnegas. The employees had drained the liquid from 10 out of 12 compressed gas cylinders that were filled with Magnegas. The cylinders were part of a twelve-cylinder manifold. Employee #2 was placing the tenth cylinder back into the manifold and Employee #1 was getting the eleventh cylinder ready for draining when it…

events.title: Employee Falls And Is Killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Moss Marine, Inc. Fort Myers Beach, FL. At approximately 12:15 p.m. on April 14, 2015, Employee #1 was pressure washing a roof of barn side to prepare it for a paint job. He was working at an unspecified height. As Employee #1 worked, he lost balance and fell, sustaining unspecified injuries that killed him.

events.title: Employee Is Crushed and Killed By Glass Panel Weight
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Permasteelisa North America Corp. Miami, FL. At 1:45 p.m. on April 13, 2015, an employee was preparing a crate while removing6 ft X 7 ft glass panels. The employee was pinned to the ground and crushed by weight of the four panels that fell on top of him once the shipping crate was opened. The employee was killed onsite.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted by contact with an overhead power l…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: R/J Group, Inc. New Smyrna Beach, FL. At 1:00 a.m. on March 27, 2015, an employee was removing a 20-foot channel iron(bar) from a commercial buildings' roof. The employee lost his footing, andtripped with the channel iron (bar). The bar came into contact with a 13,200 KVoverhead power lines that may have been too close to the work zone, and the employee was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by glass table
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Aimco Properties, Lp. Miami Beach, FL. At 7:30 p.m. on March 27, 2015, an employee was working on an apartment complex perimeter gate. The employee was struck in the head by a glass table top, which fell from a residents ninth floor balcony. The glass table top was blown off thebalcony during a period of high winds, which was seen and captured on surveillance video.The impalement caused blunt force trauma to head and face. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee run over by an International Box Truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Southeastern Sash & Door, Inc. Fort Walton Beach, FL. At 3:00p.m. on March 21, 2015, and employee was changing the engine oil on an International 4300 Box Truck. The employee was laying on the ground under the front of the truck and asked his son to start the engine to ensure there were noengine oil leaks. The employee's son was unaware that the truck was in gear. The employee's son pressed in the clutch, started the truck, and let out the clutch which caused the truck to lurch forward. The right front vehicle tire rested on the victim's chest.…

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by motorcycles
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Shenandoah General Construction Co. Melbourne, FL. At 11:00 p.m. on March 19, 2015, an employee was driving a vacuum truck with theboom in the raised position when he hit a power line. The power line fell to theground and the employee attempted to pick up the power line. the employee received an electrical shock and was thrown into traffic, where he was then struck and killed by two motorcycles.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted and killed while installing power l…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mastec North America, Inc. Merritt Island, FL. At 2:55 p.m. on March 10, 2015, an employee was working from the basket of a truck aerial lift, re-installing power distribution lines onto the concrete polecross arm. The employee was electrocuted when the energized lines not properly insulated made contact and electrocuted the employee.

events.title: Employee killed when caught in scissor lift
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Creative Environmental Services Inc. Sarasota, FL. At 1:45 p.m. on February 26, 2016, an employee was moving a scissor lift from one theater to another inside building, so that he could continue to perform demolition in the next room. The employee's head got wedged in between the top rail of the scissor lift and the top of a door frame. The employee was killed from asphyxia.

events.title: Employee falls while working on stilts and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Azs Drywall, Llc. Summerfield, FL. At 10:12 a.m. on February 25, 2015, an employee was installing 4 x 12 sheets of drywall while walking on stilts. The drywall was leaned against the wall and fell over onto the employee. He fell backwards, hit his head on the concrete floor and was killed due to severe head trauma.

events.title: Employee falls from scaffold and is killed
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Cr Construction, Inc. Orlando, FL. At 3:15 p.m. on February 2, 2015, an employee was repairing a third-story window. The employee fell off the scaffold he was standing on, approximately 22feet to the ground and was killed.

events.title: Worker installing plywood sheets for roof falls and is kille…
events.description: 3 worker deaths. Employer: Richard & Rice Construction Company, Inc. Fort Myers, FL. At 8:30 a.m. on January 31, 2015, Employee #1, employed by a home builder, was working at a multiemployer construction site. He was installing plywood sheets on the roof of a building under construction. Employee #1 fell through the rafters on to a concrete slab, a fall height of 16 feet. His head hit the concrete slab, sustaining blunt force trauma. Employee #1 was killed. The subsequent investigation determined that Employee #1 was using a personal fall arrest system, but it was not properly…

events.title: Employee Crushed and killed by Heavy Wood Grinder/Mulcher Do…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: American Mulch & Groundcover, Llc. Spring Hill, FL. At 2:30 p.m. on January 20, 2015, an employee and his supervisor were changing grates on a Morbark 6600 wood grinder/mulcher. The supervisor told the employee to take a break while he waited on customers. As he returned from assisting customers, the supervisor heard the employee banging on metal and looked up towards the top of grinder where he saw the door closing on top of the employee. Emergency services were contacted and the employee was pronounced dead at the scene.

events.title: Employee Fractures Head and is killed While Changing Crane T…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Patti Marine Enterprises, Inc. Pensacola, FL. At 3:30 p.m. on January 20, 2015, an employee was changing a tire on a crane. The employee was sitting on a pail in front of the tire hammering with a large hammer on the rim and tire. The rim split and struck the employee in his head, fracturing it. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in a fall from an elevated scissor lift p…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Publix Super Markets, Inc. Hialeah, FL. At approximately 7:15 a.m. on January 19, 2015, an employee was unloading a truck with a pallet jack from an elevated scissor lift platform. He fell backward from a platform that was 55 inches high. The hydraulic, scissor lift platform did not have a guardrail on the back side. The employee struck his head on the concrete floor and the employee was taken to the hospital where died. died.

events.title: Employee falls through a floor opening and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Aztec Concrete And Pumping Inc. Naples, FL. At 1:45 p.m. on January 14, 2015, Employee #1 and a coworker were working as subcontractors at a multi-employer construction site for a residential building.Employee #1 was assisting a coworker in cutting wood for forming. They were on the second floor of the structure. Employee #1 fell from an opening in the floor to the ground below, a fall height of 10.6 feet. Employee #1 was killed in the fall. A subsequent investigation determined that the employee had sustained fractures to his vertebrae…

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by falling pallets
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Restaurant Depot, Llc. Miami, FL. At 10:15 a.m. on January 8, 2015, an employee was moving a stack of wooden pallets through an large doorway onto a receiving dock with a forklift. The toppallets on the stack struck the top of the opening causing the top three pallets to fall and strike the employee in the head and face. The employee was killed by the severe head trauma with a fractured skull and facial bones.

events.title: Employee dies from fall into well pit after exposure to gaso…
events.description: 6 worker deaths. Employer: Clean Fuels Of Indiana, Inc. Daytona Beach, FL. At 9:00 a.m. on January 1, 2015, Employee #1 was carrying a fuel transfer hoses and piping between an in-ground tank access points. Employee #1 was overexposed to aromatic chemical components of gasoline vapors, and he was killed when he fell into an unguarded in-ground confined space pump well.
